Reviewer: AUD-SOL-F56-119, operator agent 119. Independent T4 restack-delta approval of F6's test-only slice, **not integrated recurring-release approval**. [Candidate scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/686)

### Evidence applicability and provenance
G09 reuses this model's F6 approval at `7be7d396dcaab5f62c941a78e6e071ce3518ad28`: all three owned specs are byte-identical, +1,355/-0, stable own-diff patch-id `f14b1e32b05a18b70d1b05bd401f2a0a99e546f2`. Prior original money/recovery finding closures remain scoped as recorded; C-627-10 remains its directed nullable-key follow-up. No other lens's approval was borrowed. [Prior Sol verdict / closure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/686#issuecomment-5975835306) [Current head](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b)

All 11 F6 first-parent restacks reconstruct to their automatic recorded trees, with **zero conflict-resolution hunks**; all 45 stack-lineage merges since the prior F6 approval, excluding main's existing ancestry, also reconstruct exactly. F6's entire since-approval delta equals F5's (`94c65f22f0c3e8fb7e417ebfdf9b00b0af33641d`), and every inherited money-runtime/API/fixture hunk was read alongside refund/dispute routing, charge fencing, recovery CAS/lock order, settlement/backfill, terminal and notification paths. [Audited top history](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commits/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b) [Inherited FR17](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/686#issuecomment-5983285828)

R75 range `b644198b..8cb7b2d4` is clean (as-any -14; as-unknown-as/as-never/empty-catch-undefined net zero), and dependencies/policy match the base. The pending fees migration remains data-preserving except its previously reviewed uniqueness swap; its subsequent notice-column edits are additive and limited to the unreleased CREATE TABLE, with the OR-113-4 pending-prefix disposition explicitly retained, not falsely described as newer than production. [Integrated inputs](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b) [Migration disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/681#issuecomment-5976288593)

### Independent integrated evidence and release boundary
New probe commit `be1444d898a529b8098953c383086c9ba034ac0e` has sole parent the exact candidate and adds only one spec; lane wrapper `ed214c1ca1ab5a48a1aabbe1bc8ea9b49c529902` executes real settlement/orchestrator/ledger/lock/refund-dispute services with simulated providers. **117 pass / two outside-diff dependency failures:** all 112 original owned tests pass, as do five new controls proving JPY refund/netting, true page-two reversal adoption after expired keys without another create, non-null invoice-cursor rejection/recovery without duplicate payout, malformed second refund-page fail-closed and unchanged one-time dispute access. [Independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950)

**Integrated release dependency R-DISPUTE-PAUSE:** a fresh recurring dispute on a plan whose renewal never failed keeps `entitlement_active=true`; won-dispute handling changes status to `paid`, and the fees-only tree has no subscription-pause call. When the probe models access already false before closure, that flag stays false; status restoration alone is not proof of restored access. [Executed dependency cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950) [Runtime boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts#L948-L1094)

Guide rule 9 routes this outside-owned-diff release prerequisite to F4/recurring/dunning runtime owners, rather than inventing an A/B in F6's unchanged tests. Recommended default: **no recurring production release** until the actual composed runtime proves immediate Stripe billing pause/access end for any disputed plan charge, persisted pause authority, later renewal/retry exclusion, no automatic restore, coach-controlled restart and matching client copy.

### C-686-1 — retained optional coverage gap
`test/s-fee-renewal-backfill.spec.ts:213-219` still starts without saved cursor progress and never asserts preservation. Minimal fix: seed a non-null `INVOICE_BACKFILL_CURSOR`, reject the invoice list, assert request/saved cursors, then resume and prove no second payout. The new independent seeded-cursor case passes current runtime; it does not change the candidate's original assertion gap or prove malformed-page cursor handling is repaired. [Candidate test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/8cb7b2d4bee3bccb65596581f84bccf9227ffc4b/test/s-fee-renewal-backfill.spec.ts#L213-L219) [Independent cursor case](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086/job/111514467950)

### CI / landing
All seven applicable required stacked-base contexts are successful at the exact candidate; build-and-test executes all seven inherited/owned F5/F6 suites and reports **741 passed suites / 12,786 passed tests**, with 23 skipped suites / 241 skipped tests / five todo disclosed, not acceptance evidence. Main-only CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM remain unexecuted landing gates; duplicate cancelled readiness-comment failures have superseding successful checks. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37225036263) [FR17 context](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/686#issuecomment-5983285828)

Inherited top-probe run is deliberately red: **373 pass / 54 MUTANT failures**, every failure confined to fee-190bps 41, fence-always-passes three, no-send-start-budget three and no-forward-netting seven; controls and other probes pass. [Inspected inherited workflow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37225776608)

Collapse/land fees as one only after dual approval of every piece, re-prove the collapsed bottom tree against this top and execute all main-required gates; integrate/audit recurring/dunning and mobile #321 prerequisites before claiming release readiness. No local heavy execution, candidate-branch modification, provider/production action or deployment was performed.
